name: Clyb geometric extrapolation
plain: A three-evaluation single-step: evaluates at the geometric mean sigmas between current and σ↓ and extrapolates x0 to σ↓ with Newton divided differences. Three model calls per step.
math:
σ_g1=√(σ·σ↓), σ_g2=√(σ_g1·σ↓). x0₁=model(x,σ). x_m1=lerp(x0₁,x,σ_g1/σ). x0₂=model(x_m1,σ_g1). x0_pred=x0₂+s₁₂(σ↓−σ_g1). x_m2=lerp(x0_pred,x_m1,σ_g2/σ_g1). x0₃=model(x_m2,σ_g2).
x0_f=x0₃+d2(σ↓−σ_g2)+d2_div(σ↓−σ_g2)(σ↓−σ_g1) except on final step. x=lerp(x0_f,x_m2,σ↓/σ_g2). Noise as Clyb BDF.

props.prediction_space: x0 in σ; flow branch on CONST
